IJGIS article on Hybrid meshing algorithm for multiresolution terrain models

International Journal of Geographic Information Science (IJGIS) did accept and publish an article about an "Extended hybrid meshing algorithm for multiresolution terrain models" by Enrique Paredes, M. Bóo, M. Amor, J.D. Bruguera and Jürgen Döllner. It did appear in IJGIS Volume 26, No. 5 in May 2012.
